2d42e66601.q: How can artificial intelligence compress real estate due diligence timelines from 90 days to a single day?
2d42e66601.a: Rely's AI-powered software automates lease file audits, utility audits, contract audits, and financial audits on apartment complexes. The platform uses AI for document processing to read, scan, organize, and search information to run audits, which would have been impossible without current AI capabilities, compressing what typically takes 60 to 90 days of due diligence into completion the day data is received.
